paper.title: Topology Optimization of Wind Farm Layouts

optimizer_backend.paper: Svanberg MATLAB MMA supplied to the paper author; official GCMMA-MMA 1.5 MATLAB source is currently available under GPLv3 from smoptit.se
optimizer_backend.resolution: same MMA algorithm family with explicit gradients; q continuation is reconstructed as ten-evaluation stages; the 0.1 paper moving limit is supplied as the NLopt initial step because the unavailable author wrapper cannot be replayed exactly

hpc_parameters.reason: align internal dual accuracy with the paper's 1e-8 requested precision and prevent NLopt defaults 1e-14/100000 from dominating the parallel evaluator

optimizer_backend.claim_boundary: declared open replacement, not the author MATLAB wrapper replay; restarting NLopt at each continuation stage does not preserve author wrapper/asymptote state

paper_source_conflicts.paper: modified 2016 Bastankhah Gaussian model with x0
paper_source_conflicts.resolution: paper controls; near-wake continuity follows the cited Stanley-Ning lineage

paper_source_conflicts.paper: 200 m pitch and 124 sites shown in Fig. 3 but no numeric origin
paper_source_conflicts.resolution: 100 m half-cell offset is the unique centered square grid giving 124 points inside radius 1300 m

missing_information: author MATLAB wind-farm and topology-optimization source
author MMA wrapper and internal asymptote states
machine-readable optimized density fields and raw 101-run results
the numeric convergence reference q-bar is visibly omitted after the equals sign in the published PDF; the reported runs terminate at q=3.5 and q=4 despite qmax=10

constraints.implementation_reduction: one unordered constraint per adjacent pair; the paper's directed duplicates are mathematically redundant

hpc_execution.single_run: all requested workers partition direction-target objective and analytical-gradient work
hpc_execution.multi_start_campaign: independent starts are distributed across all requested workers and share the immutable wake-deficit matrix; workers per run are floor(total_workers/run_parallelism)
hpc_execution.ordered_semantics: each MMA state trajectory remains serial; only independent wake targets or independent starts execute concurrently

paper_native_formal_protocol.random_density_semantics: the paper says all variables were uniformly initialized to one randomly chosen scalar in the stated interval; one common sampled density is therefore assigned to every site in a run
paper_native_formal_protocol.linear_interpolation_ablation: same default plus 100 random starts per case with q=0
paper_native_formal_protocol.postprocessing_completion: the paper reports near-discrete final densities but no numerical classification tolerance; rho > 0.5 is the declared installed-turbine rule
